title: Hi Friends, looking for feedback! Forbidden Recipe
author: Available-Cover-1211
selftext:
Hi friends!  
  
I've been building Forbidden Recipe, a chaotic cooperative cooking game with a hand-painted watercolor look. You play witch apprentices trying to follow a forbidden recipe while the kitchen falls apart around you.  
  
Play free in your browser (phone or desktop, no download, no signup needed to start):  
[https://forbiddenrecipe.org](https://forbiddenrecipe.org)  
  
What it is:  
\- Frantic cooking with a friend: chop, stir, serve, and try not to burn the kitchen down.  
\- A village to rebuild between games: Library, Tavern, Tailor, Dorm, Garden and Arena. You use builders and coins to upgrade them over time.  
\- Raids against other players' villages (async, you play against their "ghosts").  
\- English and French.  
  
It's free to play. There are some optional purchases (permanent extra builders), but nothing is needed to enjoy the game.  
  
What I'd love feedback on:  
1. Is the first minute clear? Did you understand what to do without help?  
2. Did you finish a first game? If not, where did you stop?  
3. Does the village and upgrade loop make you want to come back?  
4. Any bug, anything confusing, or anything that felt unfair.  
  
It's a solo project and I read every comment. Thanks for playing, and tell me what you'd change!
